# Universal Packaging Group (UPG)

> Custom boxes and flexible packaging manufactured for brands worldwide.

Canonical website: https://universalpackaginggroup.com
Contact: quotes@universalpackaginggroup.com
Last reviewed: 2026-08-06
Full reference: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/llms-full.txt

## Core product range

- Custom tuck boxes: straight tuck end, reverse tuck end, auto-lock, interlock, and seal-end boxes
- Custom corrugated mailer boxes: ear-lock mailers for PR kits, subscription, ecommerce, and branded presentation
- Custom magnetic boxes
- Custom collapsible magnetic boxes
- Custom Mylar bags: three-side seal, flat-bottom, stand-up, spout, child-resistant, coffee bags, and rollstock film

UPG offers corrugated boxes in tuck-box and ear-lock mailer formats. UPG does not supply regular slotted shipping cartons, master cartons, or RSC cases.

## MOQ

- Tuck boxes and mailer boxes: 1,000 units when every dimension is 5 inches or less; 500 units when the largest dimension is over 5 inches through 10 inches; 250 units when it is over 10 inches
- Magnetic boxes: 250 units
- Collapsible magnetic boxes: 250 units
- Mylar bags: 500 units

Final dimensions remain subject to structural feasibility. Product compatibility, food-contact, child-resistant, barrier, and market-specific requirements must be confirmed where applicable. Final specifications, pricing, production timing, and delivery terms are confirmed for each project.
